text: S552 pinpoints the repeated Polo defect: source indices 13/14 are absent from the same five CUT receiver blocks in both cm generations and the mm CLO export. Incoming edges are 0.0456–0.0470 cm; omitted-corner deviation is 0.0127–0.0140 cm against 0.001 cm. Official docs and prior tested controls provide no verified CLO fix, and stage attribution remains unknown. Keep all gates held; qualify a rights-reviewed industrial receiver/profile next.
